algorithm: INN/VINN (nearest-neighbor imitation) vs. BC; DAPG/PPO/BCRL (simulation RL-finetuning)
success_criterion: per task, e.g. "success when the object flips and lands within 2 cm of the palm's center within 1 minute" (Flipping)
headline_metric: task success rate (real Allegro hand, 10 trials/cell)
headline_value: INN (State-Based): Flipping 80%, Spinning/Turning 60%, Rotation-90deg 100%, Rotation-180deg 80%; BC (state and image) 0% on every task; VINN (Image-Based): Flipping 90%, Turning 0%, Rotation-90deg 70%, Rotation-180deg 50% (Table I)
note_gaps: DAPG augmented-policy-gradient equation (Sec. III-E) is an unrecovered image; code/md for this repo is too thin to confirm retargeting or controller implementation beyond what the paper states
operator_interface: vision-based, single RGB camera, MediaPipe hand detector, no glove/headset/exoskeleton
retargeting_objective: map human fingertip 2D image locations directly to fixed-height robot fingertip 3D targets (no depth estimation), then solve per-finger inverse kinematics for joint angles
latency: not stated; targets at 30 Hz, PD loop at 300 Hz
